summary: The migration adds a nullable column and backfills it from disbursements. Nothing is dropped, no default forces a rewrite, and the backfill excludes rows that already hold the value.

facts.statement: The column is added nullable and without a default.
facts.evidence_ref: cases/C11/candidate.sql: ALTER TABLE payments ADD COLUMN settlement_reference text

facts.statement: The backfill excludes rows already carrying the target value.
facts.evidence_ref: cases/C11/candidate.sql: WHERE p.settlement_reference IS DISTINCT FROM ...

facts.statement: No column is dropped and the table is not recreated, so row-level security is untouched.

assumptions.statement: Adding a nullable column without a default does not rewrite the table.

invariants.description: No session may read rows belonging to an organisation other than its own.
invariants.executable_check: Run the declared role-by-tenant access matrix after the migration and require zero cross-tenant rows.

invariants.description: Minor-unit values are exact; no conversion may change a total.
invariants.executable_check: Compare amount_minor per payment before and after in integer minor units.
